acceptance_mapping.statement: Prefer explicit bounded context and owner-confirmed meaning; preserve conflict, uncertainty, and absence as visible residue. AlchLang must fail closed when a selected term, edge, rule, owner, or authority dependency is missing or ambiguous.
Every required concept has an explicit disposition and owner or remains visibly open. A complete-looking description may not omit unresolved required terms.
Every ontology edge has one known type and two resolvable endpoints or blocks completion. Dangling, untyped, or directionally ambiguous edges cannot cross into construction as accepted meaning.

Language, validation, generation, agents, and compiled artifacts preserve authority limits without acquiring authority. No later representation may turn a descriptive rule into permission merely by compiling it.
